topLine: xAI opens Grok Build 0.1 coding model to the API.

items.headline: xAI opens Grok Build 0.1 coding model to the API
items.summary: Grok Build 0.1, the coding model behind xAI's Grok Build agent, became available in public beta on the xAI API at $1/$2 per million input/output tokens and over 100 tokens per second. It replaced Grok Code Fast 1, which was retired from the API in May 2026.
